match.title: Namibia vs Zimbabwe
match.h2h: In men's T20 international cricket, Zimbabwe leads the head-to-head record against Namibia with 9 wins to Namibia's 8 across their 17 total encounters. Cricket Head-to- Head Overview Total T20 Matches: 17 Zimbabwe Wins: 9 Namibia Wins: 8 Last Meeting: Zimbabwe defeated Namibia by 7 wickets on October 4, 2025, during the T20 World Cup Africa Qualifier Regional Final.
